src: Library 3D model links. A parametric link has no stored model: its `parametric` spec (a shape and its dimensions in millimetres) is drawn by the viewer, the same way every time. Each link's own `src` cites where the dimensions came from; values marked inferred are typical envelopes, not a standard's figures.

links.name: DE-9 female (parametric)
links.src: Parametric female DE-9 (D-sub shell size E): flange 30.81 x 12.55 mm, mounting-hole pitch 24.99 mm, contact pitch 2.77 mm, row pitch 2.84 mm (IEC 60807-3 / DIN 41652 outline, rounded); shell and housing depths are typical (inferred); the female shell is drawn to fit inside the male one (inferred)

links.name: JST XH 2-pin (parametric)
links.src: Parametric JST XH 2-pin housing: 2.5 mm pitch, width (n-1) x 2.5 + 4.9 = 7.4 mm, 5.75 mm high (JST XH series housing drawing); depth 7.0 mm is typical (inferred)

links.name: Terminal block 4-way (parametric)
links.src: Parametric 4-way screw terminal block: 5.08 mm pitch (the board-to-wire convention); 10 mm body height and 8 mm depth are a typical envelope (inferred)
